mapper.insert: INSERT INTO award_delivery_task (order_id, user_id, award_id, award_type, award_key, award_value, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{awardId}, #{awardType}, #{awardKey}, #{awardValue}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, award_id, award_type, award_key, award_value, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_error, dispatch_version FROM award_delivery_task WHERE status = 0 AND next_retry_at <= NOW() ORDER BY next_retry_at LIMIT 100

SELECT order_id, user_id, award_id, award_type, award_key, award_value, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_error, dispatch_version FROM award_delivery_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 1, attempts = attempts + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 0
UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1
UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 3, last_error = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1

UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= 10 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END, last_error = #{reason}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, attempts)) SECOND), update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1

UPDATE award_delivery_task SET attempts = attempts + 1, status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 10 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END, last_error = #{reason}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, attempts + 1)) SECOND), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, award_id, award_type, award_key, award_value, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_error, dispatch_version FROM award_delivery_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 0, next_retry_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (3, 4)
UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 2, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (3, 4)
UPDATE award_delivery_task SET status = 4, last_error = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (3, 4)
